confidence_notes: The FX figure is from a search of the RBA exchange-rates page. The latest observation it showed was 18 November 2026, at 0.6720 USD per AUD. I ran only one food and drink search, and it returned individual venue menus (cappuccino about $5 to $5.50, happy-hour cocktails $8 to $10, wine $7.50 to $8) with no citywide average. The meal, beer, cocktail and wine anchors combine those data points with general knowledge of Denver. Cocktail and wine are set relative to a draft beer of about $8. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not based on any search or live listing. Hostel and 1-star prices are the least certain, and prices vary with the season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Comparable to other mid-to-high-cost US Mountain West and West Coast cities, such as Portland and Seattle, but slightly cheaper than Seattle.
